category: Inventory and Control of Software Assets (02)
subcategory_text: Actively manage all software on the network to ensure only authorised software is installed and executed, and that authorised software is current with the latest security updates.
implementation_examples: IG1: Maintain software inventory; remove unsupported software
IG2: Use application allowlisting; use software inventory tools
IG3: Use binary whitelisting; utilise reputation services
assessment_objectives: Determine whether only authorised software runs.
